title: Form 9
alt: Four panels. 1: Pip stands in the office holding a returned case folder and says it came back; Margo watches from behind her desk. 2: Close-up of Pip slumped and sad, the flame a tiny dot, a lavender folder on the floor; a caption reads Case 4790, Returned: Exceeds Small. 3: Close-up of a form titled Form 9, Request for Recess, Employee Pip, Duration as long as needed, Approved M. Voss, with a pen writing. 4: Margo holds the form and her mug is set beside Pip. Pip, flame lit again, asks if it is in triplicate. Margo says obviously, the pink copy is hers.
hover: Duration: as long as needed. She never counts that one aloud.
transcript: Panel 3 – Form 9, Request for Recess. Employee: Pip. Duration: as long as needed. Approved: M. Voss. SFX: scratch scratch
Panel 4 – PIP: Is it in triplicate?
Panel 4 – MARGO: Obviously. Pink copy's mine.
note: Some cases are too big for this floor. Nobody files a form for that, so Margo did.
